note: Readable fixed-source manifest. Executable definitions/network policy live in radarlib.py; editing this file does not expand collector access.

sources.name: OpenAI news
sources.limitation: Official news RSS; metadata/excerpts, not all product documentation.

sources.name: Anthropic news
sources.limitation: News index plus section sitemap; bounded lookback, article metadata/excerpts.

sources.name: Anthropic engineering
sources.limitation: Engineering index membership retained across /research/ canonical URLs; bounded sitemap reconciliation.

sources.name: Anthropic research
sources.limitation: Research index plus section sitemap; includes some engineering articles.

sources.name: Google AI blog
sources.limitation: One Google AI blog category, not every Google/DeepMind publication.

sources.name: Hugging Face blog
sources.limitation: Hugging Face hosted posts; authors may be staff, partners or community.

sources.name: pingdotgg/t3code releases
sources.limitation: Latest release Atom window; prereleases/nightlies labeled, not full release history.

sources.name: openai/codex releases
sources.limitation: Latest release Atom window; prereleases/nightlies labeled, not full release history.

sources.name: anthropics/claude-code releases
sources.limitation: Latest release Atom window; prereleases/nightlies labeled, not full release history.

sources.name: X indexed discovery leads
sources.limitation: Google News search snippets for one fixed X/OpenAI query. Index dates and wrapper links; original author/post/content/media unverified. No complete social coverage.

sources.name: LinkedIn indexed discovery leads
sources.limitation: Google News snippets for one fixed LinkedIn/AI-agents query. Index dates and wrapper links; original author/post/content/media unverified. No complete social coverage.

sources.name: arXiv cs.AI
sources.limitation: Daily cs.AI feed only; preprints are not independently verified results.

sources.name: X public sources
sources.limitation: Unconfigured: choose public author/query scope, access route and budget. No cookies or paid API calls.

sources.name: LinkedIn public sources
sources.limitation: Unconfigured: broad public-post access is not supplied by connected people search. No scraper runs or private feed access.

sources.name: Manually saved public links
sources.limitation: Only explicitly supported public domains; social links are stored as uninspected links, not fetched.
